adit.name: Mine Adit
adit.desc: A timbered tunnel slopes north. A horn of black powder hangs on a peg.

shaft.name: The Shaft
shaft.desc: The lift cage is a wreck. Heat rolls from the north. A side cut runs east.

locker.name: Tool Locker
locker.desc: Powder horns, a coat of scales, and a thick red vial sit on a bench.

furnace.name: The Furnace
furnace.desc: A cold furnace blocks the north drift. Three cups wait in a row.

forge.name: The Forge
forge.desc: The forge is the size of a chapel, and it is not empty.

powder_order.desc: Three cups on the furnace. A soot-stained note says: black, then grey, then white.
powder_order.success_msg: The furnace coughs awake. The drift north is open.
powder_order.fail_msg: The powder flares wrong and dies. The cups are empty again.
powder_order.hint: A soot-stained note: black, then grey, then white.
